verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server that supports read-only status checks ('was my last postgres sync successful', 'are any of my connections broken') and can be switched to read/write/delete scope for write operations, plus a REST API for programmatic account/pipeline management and documented per-connector re-sync capability. This covers check-status, basic diagnosis, and re-trigger via API/MCP, though evidence for actually invoking a resync through the MCP write scope specifically (vs. general REST API) is indirect. Missing for 10: an explicit documented MCP tool/action that re-triggers a failed sync end-to-end, and deeper failure-diagnosis detail (error causes/logs) beyond a binary broken/not-broken check.
